description: This file is a C++ source implementation for the PerformanceMetrics class in the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It handles initialization, deinitialization, and metrics handling for web browser and state control observables within a plugin architecture. It also defines internal handlers for creating observables based on the queried interfaces.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing plugin performance metrics, initialization, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::CallsignPerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles creation of observable metrics based on the callsign, querying different interfaces like IWebBrowser, IBrowser, or defaulting to BasicObservable.

methods.name: PerformanceMetrics::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the observables based on configuration, registers notifications, or deinitializes if configuration is invalid.

methods.name: PerformanceMetrics::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, unregisters notifications, deinitializes handlers, and resets resources.

methods.name: PerformanceMetrics::Information
methods.description: Returns informational string about the plugin status or details.

methods.name: PerformanceMetrics::PluginActivated
methods.description: Handles plugin activation, invoking observable activation logic.

methods.name: PerformanceMetrics::PluginDeactivated
methods.description: Handles plugin deactivation, invoking observable deactivation logic.

methods.name: PerformanceMetrics::CallsignPerfMetricsHandler::CreateObservable
methods.description: Creates an observable for performance metrics based on available interface implementations in the service.
